title: 冰火季环

selectedMaster.selection: First-pass visual review: frontal eight-spoke wheel, four fixed seasonal emblems in the required order, cold left/warm right landscape, complete X-shaped stone road; executor selection only.

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE new 1024x1536 vertical opaque master painting for a premium interactive Wheel of Fortune tarot card, theme 冰火季环 (Ice and Ember Seasons). Input is an identity reference only for the Tarot symbol. Upper middle: ONE perfectly front-facing perfectly circular wheel with EXACTLY EIGHT broad radial spokes, rendered in oxidized dark iron and warm copper with icy blue inset details. Four separate fixed circular medallions around its outer corners in exact positions: upper-left spring flowers, upper-right simple golden sun, lower-left autumn leaves, lower-right snowy pine forest. They form one fixed group and must remain in these places. Scene is dramatically different from ocean and greenhouse: distant pale-cyan glacier and frost field on the left, warm charcoal and copper-red volcanic rock on the right, with their boundary visible. In the lower third a COMPLETE solid X-shaped stone road crosses the boundary and extends into both terrains, no floating fragments. Wheel floats above terrain, no support needed. Crisp painterly fantasy with natural atmosphere, cold cyan against ember red and charcoal gray, restrained metalwork, no rainbow foil baked in. Full wheel and medallions safely within the image, no human or animal, no second wheel, no extra spokes or medallions, no numbers, letters, printed title, watermark or card border. Return one full-canvas vertical illustration.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected master after first-pass visual review; no transparent layers or assembly.
